The kitchen is fully stocked with dishes, cookware, utensils, a gas stove, microwave, and a full-sized fridge. Your front porch overlooks our upper pool and has some views of Pikes Peak. This unit is perfect for a weekend retreat or as a base camp for your family’s adventures. All of the complimentary resort amenities and services are also included: two swimming pools, a TV lounge, an arcade, and Wi-Fi.
